title: Preserve newline filenames in explicit research head pins
body:
## Summary

A canonical Git filename containing LF works with `base_commit:<path>` but is rejected by the documented `head:<40-hex sha>:<path>` form. The parser's `.+` excludes LF, even though the Git readers support newline filenames. An actual temporary Git publication reproduces `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` for the base form and exit 1 for the head form with identical source bytes and commit.

Match LF as part of the exact path while retaining the lowercase 40-hex head, nonempty path and exact row-path equality requirements. Actual metadata and publication CLI regressions cover LF, CRLF, trailing LF and a later source commit, plus malformed-pin, wrong-blob, wrong-hash and working-drift controls. The documentation explains JSON escaping.

The registered `research/isolated-descendant-bytecode` consumer is also repaired: its helper row in `SOURCES.json` now says `provenance`, matching `verify.py`'s existing use of the authenticated historical Git blob. The original base, blob and SHA256 are retained. `VERIFY.json`, `TASK.json`, `verify.py`, `RESULT.json` and all three registered commands are unchanged. The current helper remains a declared replay input and the unchanged third command exercises its bytecode isolation. The README records the correction and preserves Arham Tahir's source credit; no validator exception or regenerated historical evidence is introduced.

Six source-role regressions cover the old failure versus corrected success, unchanged historical identities/evidence, corrupted blob/hash rejection, unrelated live-pin rejection, planner/publication coverage and deliberate live-isolation breakage rejected by the registered command. The same correction is included in both #3615 and #3635 so either can integrate first.

This is source declaration compatibility, separate from #3615's original-object binding, #3629's export containment and #3628's CI glob matching. No mathematical result or selected frontier changes. Credit [Aaron Wang's head-pin support in #2737](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2737), Douglas Colkitt's package runner, and [Arham Tahir's newline-preserving Git reader work in #1595](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1595).

## Validation

Local macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.14. Final tested commit: `cff9aac252b4bd9968a39c7cd0d12fce19fefab2`.

- [x] The three-method head-pin suite produces four failures against the base, covering three multiline names and a later head. Malformed-pin controls pass before and after.
- [x] 54 focused test methods pass on the final head: head-pin paths (3), source-role compatibility (6), diagnostics (16), source history (12), Git batch (7) and Git compatibility (10).
- [x] Full affected registered consumer: unchanged 16-case historical differential, 11 isolated-runner tests and eight current-helper tests; `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.
- [x] Committed publication-byte/source-history preflight: 13 files; original source base `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c` retained.
- [x] Combined #3615 and #3635 production changes: all 15 new regression methods and the full affected registered replay pass.
- [x] `git diff --check`.
- [ ] Hosted CI and native Windows/Linux execution. The real newline filename fixtures run on POSIX and skip Windows; no full repository-wide historical/theorem replay is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_head_pin_paths.py' -v
python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_descendant_source_roles.py' -v
python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_package_diagnostics.py' -v
python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_source_history.py' -v
python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_git_batch.py' -v
python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_git_compatibility.py' -v
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/isolated-descendant-bytecode
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/isolated-descendant-bytecode --check-source-history
git diff --check
```

Canonical main was rechecked unchanged at `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. The refreshed overlap inventory includes 344 open PRs, 2,964 closed PRs and 2,453 Discussion records, with complete pagination and no warnings. Predecessors and disjoint pending fixes were retained as context; no equivalent parser correction was identified. This is not an exhaustive novelty claim.

Prepared for roger-sato with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Same-session agent review is not independent human acceptance.
